correctness.rationale: The literal historical comparison of the cited versioned theorem statements is correct. Reche v1 Corollary 1.3 gives the modular specialization with θ=1/6, and Soundararajan–Young Theorem 1.1 gives 25/36 for the same weighted hyperbolic conjugacy-class count. Exact substitution gives 81/36+106/6+33=1905/36=635/12, not 1905/12 as printed at RESULT.md line 29. Using the correct value independently gives η=(√1905−27)/24. The two strict tests are 1905−43²=56 and 131²−9·1905=16. The supplied code and output were inspected, not executed; they test the correct closed form but would not catch the wrong intermediate fraction. Kaneko v3 Corollary 1.2 does state 2/3+ε for the full modular group, with EΓ defined after subtraction of the explicit small-eigenvalue main terms, including s=1. This PASS concerns the stated exponents in the specified versions, not an independent proof of those theorems or a claim that 2/3 represents Kaneko's latest result. In v4 Kaneko directly uses ΨΓ−x and gives 9/13+ε. The new comparison 9/13<η follows from 169·1905−567²=456>0.
